svg.aria-label: The original schedule: one block per angle and group walking its hyperplanes
svg.title: The original schedule: one block per angle and group walking its hyperplanes
svg.text: Original schedule: one thread block per (angle, group)
Each block walks its angle's hyperplanes in order, one element per thread, with a block barrier between them.
per SM: 1.78 waves on an A100,
so the last wave is partial.
One block (64 threads) on a 5³ mesh: threads busy per hyperplane
At most 19 of 64 threads ever have work; at 32³ hyperplanes reach 768 elements, so only the
first and last few are narrow there. Each busy thread solves a whole 8×8 system on its own.
